recipe.title: Porridge with cinnamon apple compote
steps: Put the apples, raisins, cinnamon, lemon juice and 100ml of the water in a small saucepan. Cover and simmer over a medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the apples are soft but still holding their shape.
Meanwhile, put the oats, the rest of the water and the salt in a medium saucepan and bring to the boil. Turn the heat down and simmer for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Check the compote. If it looks dry, add a splash more water so it is loose and syrupy.

Spoon the porridge into bowls and top with the warm apples and their juices. Add a spoonful of peanut butter to each and scatter over the pumpkin seeds. Leftover compote keeps in the fridge for 3 days.
